about_short_description.short_description: Drive Terra is an electric mobility technology company that provides battery-swapping infrastructure.

product.name: Battery Swapping Infrastructure
product.description: Battery-swapping stations replace depleted batteries with charged ones for electric delivery vehicles, reducing charging downtime and supporting continuous fleet operation.

product.name: Terra Cloud
product.description: A cloud platform for monitoring battery-swapping stations and managing connected energy assets through telemetry, maintenance, and energy-management functions.

product.name: Fleet Intelligence
product.description: Fleet-management software providing driver scoring, route optimization, demand prediction, and anomaly detection for electric delivery operations.

product.name: Battery as a Service (BaaS)
product.description: A battery subscription service that lets electric two-wheeler operators use Terra batteries and swapping stations without purchasing or managing the battery fleet.

product.name: Mobility as a Service (MaaS)
product.description: A subscription offering that combines Terra electric bikes, batteries, and battery swapping for commercial riders and fleet deployments.

product.name: Terra Franchise Model
product.description: A regional expansion service that enables local partners to operate Terra battery-swapping stations and fleets using Terra technology, training, and supply-chain support.
